task.small_adenoma_definition: adenoma smaller than 10 mm in the source study

model.c_selection: maximum inner out-of-fold ROC AUC; ties prefer smaller C

validation.outer: 5-fold stratified out-of-fold validation repeated for five seeds
validation.inner: 4-fold stratified validation within each outer training fold
validation.ensemble_decision: majority vote across the five cross-fitted seed predictions
validation.ensemble_score: mean cross-fitted probability across the five seeds

operating_points.threshold_rule: maximize inner-OOF sensitivity subject to target specificity; ties use the specificity closest to target

uncertainty.binary_rates: Wilson 95% confidence interval on one consensus prediction per subject

reporting_boundary: Retrospective internal cross-validation of one public stool metagenomic cohort; not prospective clinical validation and not analytical validation of the colorimetric kit.
